results.title: Epigenetics Market by Product, Service, Method, Technique, Application - Global Forecast to 2031
results.description: The global epigenetics market is projected to grow from USD 2.22 billion in 2026 to USD 3.92 billion by 2031, registering a 12.0% CAGR. Growth is driven by oncology research, precision medicine, drug discovery, biomarker validation, liquid biopsies, single-cell epigenomics, multi-omics and AI-based analysis. DNA methylation is expected to be the fastest-growing segment, while next-generation sequencing will hold the largest share. The US is forecast to record the highest CAGR, supported by advanced research infrastructure and strong adoption across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic and clinical settings.
